# data.docker_stacks

<!-- Code generated by tools/genskill from the provider schema. DO NOT EDIT. -->

Kind: data-source. Back to [SKILL.md](../SKILL.md).

Lists the Swarm stacks, like `docker stack ls`: services grouped by the `com.docker.stack.namespace` label, with the number of services in each (`services_count`). Needs a Swarm manager.
